📖 How this report works

What it shows

Every address on your vendors' accounts, of every address type, with its city, state, zip and (optionally) country. It is the BI version of the standard Vendor Address report and reads the same data the same way.

Name is the address's own name, as in the standard report; it is usually the vendor's name but need not be. Tick Vendor name to see the vendor beside it. Click a name to open the vendor.

Using it
  • Filter changes apply straight away. Active vendors only by default; tick Inactive vendors to add (or, alone, to list only) the inactive ones.
  • Sort by orders the list as the standard report does (Country sorts by the country's code, State by the state code).
  • Click a column heading to sort by it instead (again to reverse, a third time for the Sort by order). Drag a heading onto another to move the column; drag a heading's right edge to resize it. Your layout is remembered; Settings → Reset column layout undoes it.
  • The Table / Pivot selector switches to a pivot: the number of addresses by any two of vendor, address type, state, country, city, zip and vendor status. Click a count to see the addresses behind it. Print, PDF and Excel follow the view on screen.
  • The App / PDF buttons in the header switch between this interactive view and the printable pages, laid out like the standard report. In PDF view pick the paper size and orientation in the bar above the pages; they are remembered. Print prints those pages.
  • A very large result shows its first 10,000 addresses with a Load all button.
